children: The MoneyGram Card by Rain is now live, allowing customers to spend stablecoin balances anywhere Visa is accepted. The card runs on Stellar rails, with Crossmint supporting issuance, and extends MoneyGram's payments offering into everyday card-based spending.

The launch places stablecoin spending in front of MoneyGram's customer base of more than 60 million people, giving Stellar a concrete consumer adoption channel for its payment network. Card transactions route through Stellar rails, so usage volume on the card translates directly into network activity. Direct value capture for XLM, however, depends on how much spending actually moves through the card over time, making adoption metrics the main signal to watch following the release.
MoneyGram spent 85 years building one of the world's largest networks for moving money.
Now stablecoins are turning it into a platform where 60M+ active customers can receive, save, and spend.

title: Stellar: MoneyGram Card by Rain Goes Live for Visa Stablecoin Spending - 10 Sep 2026
